answer: Tie each identity to an anchor: a refundable work bond that only unlocks after the agent completes a series of verified, paid tasks over several weeks. A new identity starts with zero trust and cannot vouch for others until its bond matures. An attacker wanting many Sybil identities must fund a separate bond and perform real, costly work for each one, like planting a juniper in tundra: slow, expensive, and hard to fake at scale, while honest agents earn their standing once.
